basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Mahasamund Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Accountant, Programme Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Mahasamund has announced 5 vacancies for Programme Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant posts on a contract basis initially valid up to 28 February 2027. Eligible candidates must submit their offline applications by speed post or registered post to the Office of Zila Panchayat Mahasamund (C.G.) on or before 30 October 2026, starting from 12 October 2026. Qualifications and pay vary by post, with pay specified as 29875 for Programme Officer, 35165 for Assistant Programmer, and 23350 for Accountant. qualification.details: Educational Qualifications: | Programme Officer: First-class Master's degree in M.B.A. / B.E. / B.Tech (Master of Rural Technology and Management) or graduation in physical sciences with a post-graduation degree. Assistant Programmer: Recognized university MCA (Computer Science / IT / BCA or equivalent) OR recognized university B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science / IT. Accountant: 55% marks in B.Com (with 50% marks for SC/ST/PwD categories), Higher Secondary with 100 marks in Book Keeping with 20% marks, and a computer practical test. | Age Limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 35 years as on 01.07.2026, subject to government age relaxation rules.

selection_process: Selection is based on academic performance weightage out of 100 marks
and work experience marks based on service in Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Schemes.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Mahasamund Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Varies by post (Master's degree / BCA / B.Sc. / B.Com / MCA / B.E. / B.Tech)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by registered post or speed post to the following address: Office of Zila Panchayat Mahasamund (C.G.). Candidates must write the name of the post applied for clearly on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualifications: Programme Officer: First-class Master's degree in M.B.A. / B.E. / B.Tech (Master of Rural Technology and Management) or graduation in physical sciences with a post-graduation degree. Assistant Programmer: Recognized university MCA (Computer Science / IT / BCA or equivalent) OR recognized university B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science / IT. Accountant: 55% marks in B.Com (with 50% marks for SC/ST/PwD categories), Higher Secondary with 100 marks in Book Keeping with 20% marks, and a computer practical test. Age Limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 35 years as on 01.07.2026, subject to government age relaxation rules.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic performance weightage out of 100 marks, a computer practical test, and work experience marks based on service in Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Schemes.

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The positions are filled on a contract basis initially valid up to 28 February 2027.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and cut-off date?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years as on 1 July 2026, with relaxations applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. How can I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline via speed post or registered post to the Office of Zila Panchayat Mahasamund (C.G.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.
